content: Native customfield_value in runtime builtins renders false, zero and empty JSON correctly; choice labels/colors and sanitized Markdown are native. URL text truncates at 70 characters. get_custom_fields_by_group applies ui_visible; Parameters needs independent profile resolution. Object/multiobject deserialize and linkify do not restrict related querysets; apply native restrict(user,view) before formatting. Read-only probes confirmed these findings on pinned runtime.
